crates.name: ArgParse
crates.summary: A Rust command-line parser with an owned typed builder API and a legacy hook-based interface.

items.name: Parser
items.signature: pub struct Parser { /* private parser state */ }
items.summary: Owns argument definitions and parsed, type-checked values. The recommended API avoids borrowed Any values.

items.name: new
items.signature: pub fn new() -> Self
items.summary: Create an empty parser with no registered arguments.

items.name: flag
items.signature: pub fn flag<I, S>(&mut self, name: impl Into<String>, aliases: I) -> Result<&mut Self, ParseError> where I: IntoIterator<Item = S>, S: Into<String>
items.summary: Register a boolean flag. Its default is false; any listed alias sets it to true.

items.name: option
items.signature: pub fn option<T, I, S>(&mut self, name: impl Into<String>, aliases: I, default: T) -> Result<&mut Self, ParseError> where T: Any + Clone + std::str::FromStr, T::Err: std::fmt::Display, I: IntoIterator<Item = S>, S: Into<String>
items.summary: Register a typed option with a default. T implements FromStr and Clone.

items.name: option_with
items.signature: pub fn option_with<T, F, I, S>(&mut self, name: impl Into<String>, aliases: I, default: T, parse: F) -> Result<&mut Self, ParseError> where T: Any + Clone, F: Fn(&str) -> Result<T, String> + 'static, I: IntoIterator<Item = S>, S: Into<String>
items.summary: Register an option with a custom fallible string parser.

items.name: required_option
items.signature: pub fn required_option<T, I, S>(&mut self, name: impl Into<String>, aliases: I) -> Result<&mut Self, ParseError> where T: Any + std::str::FromStr, T::Err: std::fmt::Display, I: IntoIterator<Item = S>, S: Into<String>
items.summary: Register a typed option that must be present.

items.name: parse
items.signature: pub fn parse(&mut self) -> Result<(), ParseError>
items.summary: Parse process arguments, excluding the executable name.

items.name: parse_from
items.signature: pub fn parse_from<I, S>(&mut self, args: I) -> Result<(), ParseError> where I: IntoIterator<Item = S>, S: Into<String>
items.summary: Parse explicit arguments; useful when embedding the parser or testing.

items.name: get
items.signature: pub fn get<T: Any>(&self, name: &str) -> Option<&T>
items.summary: Read a parsed value by name and downcast it to its registered type.

items.name: usage
items.signature: pub fn usage(&self, program: &str) -> String
items.summary: Generate a usage string from the registered arguments.

items.name: ParseError
items.signature: pub struct ParseError(pub String)
items.summary: A parsing error with a readable message; implements Display and Error.

items.name: CLI
items.signature: pub struct CLI<'a>
items.summary: Legacy parser that stores borrowed, type-erased values and offers processing hooks. Prefer Parser for new code.

items.name: args
items.signature: pub args: HashMap<String, &'a dyn Any>
items.summary: Parsed values keyed by argument name; values must outlive the CLI.

items.name: preproc
items.signature: pub preproc: Option<fn(Vec<String>) -> Vec<String>>
items.summary: Transforms process arguments before parsing.

items.name: help_fxn
items.signature: pub help_fxn: fn()
items.summary: Callback run for -h or --help.

items.name: iter_fxn
items.signature: pub iter_fxn: Option<fn()>
items.summary: Callback invoked after an argument is processed.

items.name: postproc
items.signature: pub postproc: Option<fn(&'a dyn Any) -> &'a dyn Any>
items.summary: Transforms stored values after parsing.

items.name: endlogic
items.signature: pub endlogic: Option<fn()>
items.summary: Callback run after parsing and postprocessing.

items.name: new
items.signature: pub fn new() -> Self
items.summary: Create a legacy CLI with default preprocessing and help behavior.

items.name: set_preproc
items.signature: pub fn set_preproc(&mut self, fxn: fn(Vec<String>) -> Vec<String>)
items.summary: Set a function that transforms raw arguments before parsing.

items.name: set_postproc
items.signature: pub fn set_postproc(&mut self, fxn: fn(&'a dyn Any) -> &'a dyn Any)
items.summary: Set a transformation applied to stored values after parsing.

items.name: set_help
items.signature: pub fn set_help(&mut self, fxn: fn())
items.summary: Set the callback used for help requests.

items.name: set_iter
items.signature: pub fn set_iter(&mut self, fxn: fn())
items.summary: Set a callback invoked as each argument is processed.

items.name: add_flag
items.signature: pub fn add_flag(&mut self, arg_name: &'a str, flags: (Vec<&'a str>, for<'b> fn(&'b dyn Any) -> &'b dyn Any), default_val: &'a dyn Any)
items.summary: Register a legacy flag, aliases, value transform, and default.

items.name: add_flags
items.signature: pub fn add_flags(&mut self, flags: Vec<(&'a str, (Vec<&'a str>, for<'b> fn(&'b dyn Any) -> &'b dyn Any), &'a dyn Any)>)
items.summary: Register several legacy flags together.

items.name: add_param
items.signature: pub fn add_param(&mut self, arg_name: &'a str, cust_str_fxn: fn(&str) -> &'a dyn Any, default_val: &'a dyn Any)
items.summary: Register a parameter and a function that converts its string value.

items.name: add_params
items.signature: pub fn add_params(&mut self, params: Vec<(&'a str, fn(&str) -> &'a dyn Any, &'a dyn Any)>)
items.summary: Register multiple legacy parameters and string converters.

items.name: add_arg
items.signature: pub fn add_arg(&mut self, arg_name: &'a str, flags: Option<(Vec<&'a str>, for<'b> fn(&'b dyn Any) -> &'b dyn Any)>, default_val: &'a dyn Any, cust_str_fxn: Option<fn(&str) -> &'a dyn Any>)
items.summary: Register one legacy argument as either a flag or parsed parameter.

items.name: add_args
items.signature: pub fn add_args(&mut self, args: Vec<(&'a str, Option<(Vec<&'a str>, for<'b> fn(&'b dyn Any) -> &'b dyn Any)>, &'a dyn Any, Option<fn(&str) -> &'a dyn Any>)>)
items.summary: Register several legacy flags or parameters together.

items.name: Parse_Args
items.signature: pub fn Parse_Args(args: Vec<(&'a str, Option<(Vec<&'a str>, for<'b> fn(&'b dyn Any) -> &'b dyn Any)>, &'a dyn Any, Option<fn(&str) -> &'a dyn Any>)>) -> CLI<'a>
items.summary: Create a legacy CLI, register arguments, and parse process arguments.

items.name: Parse
items.signature: pub fn Parse(&mut self)
items.summary: Parse process arguments using the configured legacy entries and hooks.
